title: Comelec delists 50 party-list groups, organizations, coalitions
summary: About 50 party-list groups, organizations, and coalitions have been delisted and their registration cancelled, according to the Commission on Elections (Comelec).

blocks.text: About 50 party-list groups, organizations, and coalitions have been delisted and their registration cancelled, according to the Commission on Elections (Comelec).

The Comelec gave the following reasons: failure to participate in the last two preceding elections, failure to obtain at least two percent of votes and failed to obtain a seat in the second round of seat allocation for the party-list system in the last two preceding elections.
The groups that failed to participate in the last two (2) preceding elections are the following:

items: Ako Ayoko Sa Bawal Na Droga
Grains Retailers' Confederation of the Philippines, Inc.
Isang Lapian ng Mangingisda at Bayan Tungo sa Kaunlaran

blocks.text: Meanwhile, the groups that failed to obtain at least two percent of votes and to obtain a seat in the second round of seat allocation for the party-list system in the last two preceding elections are the following:

Ang Programang Aasenso Taumbayan- Dream, Act, Participate and Advocate for Sustainable Transformation
Babae Ako Para Sa Bayan Inc.
Banat Barangay Natin (Formerly Barkadahan Para Sa Bansa, Inc.)
